 Fiorentina will welcome Atalanta to the Stadio Artemio Franchi on Thursday for a highly anticipated Serie A encounter. 
 La Viola will be eager to end their run of three consecutive league defeats, and the Ladbrokes sign-up offer could provide an appealing option for those looking to back them in this clash.
 Meanwhile, the visiting La Dea will hope they can get back to winning ways after also failing to win their last three games across all competitions.

 Fiorentina suffered another painful setback on Sunday, surrendering a late lead against defending champions Inter Milan. 
 Paolo Vanoli’s men were still ahead in the 90th minute before conceding twice in stoppage time to suffer their third consecutive defeat. 
 They have now gone four matches without a victory, drawing once and losing three times, leaving them in the relegation zone after eight rounds. 
 Fiorentina vs Atalanta – Whispers Insight 
 Nikola Krstovic has scored five goals for Atalanta in his last three Serie A games.
 Worryingly, this is the second consecutive season in which La Viola have managed just four points at this stage of the campaign. 
 Their prospects of an immediate revival appear uncertain, particularly given their struggles at the Stadio Artemio Franchi.
 They have not won a league match since April, recording four draws and three defeats in that period.
 Meanwhile, Atalanta are also searching for a much-needed turnaround after being involved in a remarkable 4-4 draw with Frosinone on Sunday. 
 Fiorentina vs Atalanta – Whispers Insight 
 Fiorentina and Atalanta have scored against each other in four of their last six meetings across all competitions.
 That result extended their winless streak across all competitions to three matches, leaving them languishing in the bottom half of the standings. 
 Maurizio Sarri’s side have managed just one victory in their last six Serie A outings, alongside one draw and four defeats.
 Their current away form remains a major concern, with four consecutive defeats on their travels across all competitions leaving them under pressure to deliver a response in Florence.

 Whispers predicts: Fiorentina 2-1 Atalanta 
 Fiorentina and Atalanta both enter this fixture eager to bounce back from recent defeats, but we predict a 2-1 victory for the home team. 
 La Viola hold a slight psychological advantage playing in their own stadium and will be confident heading into this clash due to their previous head-to-head record.
 They have enjoyed a good run against La Dea, having remained unbeaten in their last six home meetings across all competitions.
 Ahead of this clash, the bookmakers have tipped Fiorentina as slight favourites to win at 13/10 (2.30) at home.  
 A draw is valued at 12/5 (3.40), while an away victory for Atalanta is offered at 2/1 (3.00), making them the underdogs. 
 The market for over 2.5 goals is priced at 8/11 (1.72), and both teams to score (yes) is available at 4/7 (1.57), while Nikola Krstovic anytime goalscorer is set at 7/4 (2.75).
